verdict.rationale: Mem0's search API returns the most relevant memories in a single call, with reranking to prioritize results, which covers the 'relevant memories assembled in one call' portion of the story. However, there is no evidence of a token-budget parameter or of memories being formatted into a ready-to-use prompt/context block — the docs only describe raw memory objects returned from search, not budget-aware prompt assembly. missing for 10: explicit token-budget/limit control on retrieval, evidence of a formatted 'prompt-ready' context string output, and any first-party or hands-on confirmation of this exact feature.
